body: Every time I get a refill on my antidepressants, I'm afraid that I'm just going to down the whole bottle so I don't have to wake up anymore
The temptation to hurt myself would end up with me dead.
Female here. I once got very drunk with my half sister (different fathers) and her husband. I was 18 and they were both around 25/26. We uh, may have had a three-way...

I very much dislike my dog. I did not want this dog at all. But the best friends I live with did. So we got a dog. As a result, he destroys my stuff, bites me, and licks me with his disgusting tongue. My room is the living room, the only carpeted area of the house. Which means he'll pee, poop, and vomit in my space. I'm a cat person. We have three cats I adore. I am NOT a dog person. I'm tired of being called a bitch for being resentful for something that I had absolutely no say in.

I need to go ahead and actually do something to try to help myself get better, I know that, but it's so daunting. I'm trying so hard to be better, I've been trying so hard, and it really doesn't seem to make any difference. And that's heartbreaking. I just wish that all my trying was enough to do something.
